name: repo-diagrammer
description: Read a real codebase and draw evidence-backed diagrams of any feature: C4 context/container/component, sequence, class, ER, state, dataflow, deployment, call graph, and use case diagrams.

interface.longDescription: Inspect a repository, extract structure where possible, build an evidence-backed diagram spec, render and validate Mermaid, then review the diagram against source code before delivery.
defaultPrompt: Use Repo Diagrammer to draw the architecture of this repository.
Use Repo Diagrammer to trace this feature and create a sequence diagram.
Use Repo Diagrammer to review this diagram against the code.
